intake.title: Bag intake
intake.description: Confirm physical bag counts and priority before these orders enter production.
intake.invalidBagCount: Bag count must be a whole number of zero or more.

errors.changed: This order changed while intake was open. The current order has been loaded; review it before recording again.
errors.noLongerPending: This order has already left bag intake. The current order list has been loaded.
errors.orderMissing: This order is no longer available for bag intake. The current order list has been loaded.
errors.bagCountRejected: The server rejected this bag count. Enter a whole number of zero or more and record intake again.
errors.unauthorized: Your session expired. Sign in again before recording bag intake.
errors.forbidden: Your account cannot record bag intake. Ask an owner, administrator, or production operator for access.
errors.unavailable: LPMS could not confirm the final intake state. Review the refreshed bag count and priority before trying again.
errors.invalidResponse: The production service returned order data that Processor could not read. Refresh before recording intake.
errors.recordFailed: Bag intake was not confirmed. Review the refreshed order before trying again.
